messages:
julia: Hi team, quick onboarding hiccup. Just received my company MBP (M2, macOS 13.4) and enrolled in MDM but trying to enable FileVault shows "Cannot enable FileVault: missing secure token ownership". The account is local and admin. Anyone know a safe fix that doesn't wipe my data?

it-support: welcome! :wave: Missing SecureToken usually happens if the account was created before MDM completed DEP activity or if the device was restored from backup. Can you run `sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus $(whoami)` and `id -Gn` and paste outputs?

julia: output: `Secure token is DISABLED for user julia` and `staff admin`.

it-support: ok — since you're the only user, we'll create a short-lived helper admin via MDM to grant you a SecureToken, then remove it. That avoids a wipe. Do you want us to push it now?

julia: yes please. also curious: will this touch my Keychain/permissions? I have a few installed apps with fine-grained TCC prompts.

sam: fwiw granting SecureToken doesn't change file ownership. You might need to re-consent to some TCC prompts after the temp admin is removed, but your keychain should be fine.

it-support: pushing local admin rdw-helper now (expires in 2 hrs). You'll see an MDM notification. Follow the instructions in Terminal when I ask.

it-support: MDM cmd: CreateLocalAdmin rdw-helper serial=C02ABCXXXX issued.

julia: got the notification. Terminal prompt requested an admin to authorize addUser and asked for my password — entered and it succeeded.

it-support: from the helper admin run: `sudo sysadminctl -secureTokenOn julia -password <julia_pw> -adminUser rdw-helper -adminPassword TempPass#1`

julia: ran it, no output, exit 0. Checked: `Secure token is ENABLED for user julia`.

it-support: great. Now enable FileVault: `sudo fdesetup enable -user julia` — it will produce a recovery key; the MDM should escrow it. Keep the key secret but you don't need to store it locally if MDM confirms escrow.

julia: ran enable, got a recovery key. mdm-bot: `Escrow status: RECEIVED serial=C02ABCXXXX user=julia`. Web UI now shows "Encryption: Managed (Escrowed)".

it-support: we'll remove rdw-helper now. You may see a prompt to re-authorize a few small app permissions; just allow as needed.

julia: saw a couple permission popups for Screen Recording and Full Disk Access; allowed them. All green in console. Thanks!

it-support: filed ticket IT-5012 with steps and self-serve note for future new-hires. Closing thread in 24h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
